clusters.title: Graham Platner Suspends Maine Senate Campaign Amid Assault Allegation
clusters.summary: Graham Platner has suspended his campaign for the Maine Senate seat following a sexual assault allegation made against him, which he denies. Several potential successors have already expressed interest in the Democratic nomination as the party scrambles to fill the vacancy before upcoming deadlines.

clusters.title: At least 12 dead, 23 missing in deadly wildfire in southern Spain
clusters.summary: A fast-moving wildfire in the southeastern province of Almería has resulted in at least 12 fatalities, with 23 individuals reported missing. The blaze, one of Spain's deadliest, has been exacerbated by a heatwave affecting the region. Many victims were found in burnt-out vehicles, believed to have died while attempting to escape the flames. Rescue efforts are ongoing as officials work to identify the victims.

clusters.title: Passenger Nearly Sucked Out of Window on Ryanair Flight
clusters.summary: A passenger on a Ryanair flight from Greece to Germany was nearly sucked out of a shattered window during mid-air. Witnesses reported that the man was lifted out of his seat and hung headfirst out of the window after the acrylic pane broke, allegedly due to engine failure. His wife reportedly saved him by holding onto his legs until he was pulled back inside the aircraft. The airline confirmed that the passenger received medical treatment following the incident.
